snippet.title: No Man's Sky iOS Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Sean takes us on a deep dive of what it took to get No Man's Sky running on iPhones and iPads and how we wanted to make it "best in class". 

Super-intuitive useability and built-from-the-ground-up touch controls; remarkable battery life and thermodynamics; playable on iPhone 11 and 3rd generation iPad Air and above. And with the entire game clocking in at just under 5GB, it won't max out your iPhone storage!

Releasing on October 28. Pre-order from the Apple App Store today.
